title: CSCI 603 — Computational Problem Solving
subject: Programming and Languages
description: An independent, catalog-aligned learning companion. It is not an official RIT course section or a replacement for the instructor's syllabus.
outcomes: 1. Define and apply the core components of computational thinking: abstraction, decomposition, and algorithmic expression in pseudo-code and a target
2. Demonstrate the construction and manipulation of elementary data structures (lists, trees, graphs) to model problem domains accurately.
3. Execute recursive problem-solving strategies and implement systematic debugging and testing protocols to verify program correctness.
